q-3812.name: Question 1
q-3812.worked_solution:
First, we rearrange the equation, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}-\frac{{p}^{2}}{2} & =4 \\ -{p}^{2} & =8 \\ {p}^{2} & =-8\end{aligned}
$$

By taking square root, we obtain:

$$
p=\pm \sqrt{-8}
$$

We now rewrite $p$ using the imaginary unit $\text{i}=\sqrt{-1}\,:$

$$
\begin{aligned}p & =\pm \sqrt{-8} \\  & =\pm \sqrt{8\cdot (-1)} \\  & =\pm \sqrt{8}\cdot \sqrt{-1} \\  & =\pm 2\sqrt{2}\cdot \sqrt{-1} \\  & =\pm 2\sqrt{2}\,\text{i}\end{aligned}
$$

q-8182.name: Question 2
q-8182.problem: Find the solutions of the equation $3{x}^{2}+25=0.$
q-8182.worked_solution:
First, we rearrange the equation, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}^{2}+25 & =0 \\ 3{x}^{2} & =-25 \\ {x}^{2} & =-\frac{25}{3}\end{aligned}
$$

By taking square root, we obtain:

$$
x=\pm \sqrt{-\frac{25}{3}}
$$

We now rewrite $x$ using the imaginary unit $\text{i}=\sqrt{-1}\,:$

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =\pm \sqrt{-\frac{25}{3}} \\  & =\pm \sqrt{\frac{25}{3}\cdot (-1)} \\  & =\pm \sqrt{\frac{25}{3}}\cdot \sqrt{-1} \\  & =\pm \frac{\sqrt{25}}{\sqrt{3}}\cdot \sqrt{-1} \\  & =\pm \frac{5}{\sqrt{3}}\text{i}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we rationalize the denominator:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =\pm \frac{5}{\sqrt{3}}\text{i} \\  & =\pm \frac{5}{\sqrt{3}}\cdot \frac{\sqrt{3}}{\sqrt{3}}\cdot \sqrt{-1} \\  & =\pm \frac{5\sqrt{3}}{3}\text{i}\end{aligned}
$$

q-76538.name: Question 3
q-76538.worked_solution:
First, we rearrange the equation, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{p}^{2}}{5}+15 & =0 \\ \frac{{p}^{2}}{5} & =-15 \\ {p}^{2} & =-75\end{aligned}
$$

By taking square root, we obtain:

$$
p=\pm \sqrt{-75}
$$

We now rewrite $p$ using the imaginary unit $\text{i}=\sqrt{-1}\,:$

$$
\begin{aligned}p & =\pm \sqrt{-75} \\  & =\pm \sqrt{75\cdot (-1)} \\  & =\pm \sqrt{75}\cdot \sqrt{-1} \\  & =\pm 5\sqrt{3}\cdot \sqrt{-1} \\  & =\pm 5\sqrt{3}\,\text{i}\end{aligned}
$$

If p25+15=0, then p=

a
−53i
b
−253i
c
±53i
d
53i
e
±253i
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we rearrange the equation, as follows: p25+15=0p25=−15p2=−75

By taking square root, we obtain: p=±−75

We now rewrite p using the imaginary unit i=−1:

p=±−75=±75⋅(−1)=±75⋅−1=±53⋅−1=±53i
